title: Asteroid Toutatis
body: Asteroid Toutatis passed near Earth at four times the distance to our Moon (the Moon orbits at $$3.84\times10**{8}\,\text{m}$$). $$It$$ $$has$$ $$a$$ $$mass$$ $$of$$ $$5.0\times10**{13}\,\text{kg}$$. $$Take$$ G=$$6.674\times10**{-11}\,\tfrac{\text{N}\cdot\text{m}**2}{\text{kg}**2}$$ and Earth's mass as $$5.97\times10**{24}\,\text{kg}$$.
